blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Diesel is expected to hit as high as P8.80 per liter this week, prompting oil giant Shell Pilipinas to stagger the big-time fuel price hikes. The oil firm, in an advisory, said diesel prices would increase by P7.80 per liter on Tuesday. READ: Oman says Strait of Hormuz talks with Iran, Gulf states postponed Gas and kerosene products will also be more expensive by P4.80 and P6.40 per liter, respectively. On Wednesday, motorists buying diesel from Shell would see an additional P1 per liter. Other fuel retailers have yet to announce their official price movement. The Department of Energy […]...
